sshServer._option1: Simple format - just use a host from ~/.ssh/config:

portRange._comment: Port range for SOCKS5 proxy allocation

_httpProxyHost_comment: Host/IP for the HTTP proxy server to bind to (default: 127.0.0.1)
_httpProxyPort_comment: Port for the HTTP proxy server
_inactivityTimeout_comment: Seconds of no data before restarting (default: 60)
_retryAttempts_comment: Number of restart attempts before giving up (default: 3)
_logLevel_comment: Log level: debug, info, warn, error (default: info)
_showFooter_comment: Enable footer display with live stats (default: true)
_maxSpeed_comment: Max speed for graph scaling in bytes/sec (default: 6291456 = 6MB)
_directDomains_comment: List of domains that bypass the proxy (go direct). Supports wildcards: '*.example.com' matches subdomains, 'foo-bar' matches exact hostname, '*.us' matches all .us domains
